newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open weaker, undermined by Dow drop.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open weaker, undermined by Dow drop.

text.p: London's FTSE 100 leading share index opened lower on Wednesday as a 66-point Dow drop and negative reaction to some blue-chip results dragged the market lower.
The FTSE opened 12.2 points weaker at 4,345.5 but dealers said it could bounce back and even attack record territory later in the session if it saw a follow-through from Tuesday's strength.

"We were so strong yesterday that there was a shortage of stock so I'm not sure how much notice we'll take of Wall Street," said the head of equity sales at a major investment bank. "There is scope for gains later."
